programme.title: Magnum P.I.

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: Fagmalion - Part 3: Bye, Bye, Beardy: Will and Jack reveal a newly transformed Barry at the HRC Gala, while Karen and her rival battle it out at a silent auction. (S5, ep 17)

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: Fagmailon - Part 4: The Guy Who Loved Me: Jack goes on a date with the newly re-modelled Barry and Karen poses as a maid to seduce a maintenance worker. (S5, ep 18)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart's Friend Falls in Love: Milhouse falls in love with Samantha, a new girl at school, and casts his friendship with Bart aside. (S3, ep 23)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: All's Fair In Oven War: While Marge concentrates on sabotaging a cookery competition, Bart holds a 'Playdude' party attended by Hollywood legend James Caan. (S16, ep 2)

programme.title: Big Cat Country
programme.desc: Strength in Sisterhood: In the Luangwa Valley the Hollywood pride is teetering on disaster. An attack by the invading Nomads has left matriarch Ava gravely injured. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Hawaii Five-0
programme.desc: Kahu (Guardian): McGarrett and Catherine stumble upon a backwoods moonshine operation during their search for a missing father. Star Trek's George Takei guest stars. (S3, ep 11)

programme.title: Magnum P.I.
programme.desc: Ashes to Ashes: Magnum and Higgins examine a fatal arson investigation at the request of TC and Mahina. Kumu volunteers with Rick at a crisis call centre. (S5, ep 19)

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Ekital Rashku: Hondo, Deacon, Tan and Commander Hicks engage in a manhunt across Tokyo after an extradited fugitive escapes local custody. (S3, ep 13)

programme.title: Police 24/7
programme.desc: This special episode of Police 24/7 focuses on how law enforcement deals with the growing problem of illegal substances on the streets. Flashing images. (S2, ep 48)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Don't Fear The Roofer: Stephen Hawking and US sitcom star Ray Romano appear in a landmark 350th episode. Fearing Homer's lost the plot, Marge carts him off to the loony bin. (S16, ep 16)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Sleeping With The Enemy: Lisa becomes paranoid about her weight when the kids at school make fun of her posterior. Marge, much to Bart's horror, befriends bully Nelson Muntz. (S16, ep 3)

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Pool Party: As Robert throws one last house party before he is forced to sell his mansion, Erin comes up with a plan to get Andy's attention. (S8, ep 12)

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Jury Duty: Dwight investigates when Jim takes time off work for jury duty, while Angela gives birth to a suspiciously large 'premature' baby. (S8, ep 13)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Heartbroke Kid: When Springfield Elementary installs new, cool vending machines, it's not long before an enormous Bart is off to fat camp... (S16, ep 17)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A Star is Born: American Idol winner Fantasia guest stars as Lisa's rival in a singing competition. Will Homer's songwriting make or break Lisa? (S16, ep 18)

programme.title: Rob & Romesh Vs...
programme.desc: ...The Jungle: Rob and Rom venture into the Sumatran jungle to see who can snap the most exhibition-worthy photo for Wildlife Photographer of the Year. (S8, ep 3)

programme.title: New: Harry Hill New Bits & Greatest...

programme.title: Never Mind The Buzzcocks
programme.desc: Sophie Willan, Nadine Coyle, Tom Grennan and Chris McCausland join the regulars for the legendary pop culture panel show's revival, hosted by Greg Davies. (S5, ep 7)

programme.title: Grimm
programme.desc: The Law of Sacrifice: Nick attempts to keep Adalind and her baby safe from the royals, while his mother plans out how to finally deal with them. (S3, ep 18)

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Salta Diya
programme.desc: A rich man's wife and a thief's wife simultaneously give birth to twin sons, from which two of them get exchanged. Years later, an unexpected event leads them to swap places once again.

programme.title: Khwaja Mere Khwaja
programme.desc: The plot follows the downfall of the Quadri family due to betrayal and their subsequent pursuit of peace.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Ghar Mein Ram Gali Mein Shyam
programme.desc: Amar weds a village belle and they move to the city where she meets her neighbours Mr and Mrs Dharamchand. Soon, Amar begins to doubt her fidelity and Dharamchand devises a scheme to separate them.

programme.title: Shivam
programme.desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.desc: Ngorongoro: Head into the wildlife haven on the edge of the Serengeti. Formed out of a volcanic eruption, it's home to the highest concentration of mammals in the world. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Patrick Aryee's Wild World
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Salmon: Patrick is in British Columbia for the annual salmon run, which not only ensures the species' survival but also sustains the entire rainforest ecosystem. (S1, ep 2)
